runs.text: The Transfiguration
Mark 9:1–13
After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

runs.text: The Boy with a Demon
When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
runs.originalText: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.

runs.text: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
runs.originalText: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

runs.text: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”

runs.text: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.

Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
